correlationId.description: An optional identifier for this transaction generated by the consumer (such as a random UUIDv4 string). If not supplied the WFM Partner Gateway will generate its own value.

data.description: A grouping object holding the main details of the request body

scenario.description: A field which indicates whether this request relates to a new or reschedule case.

transactionReferenceID.description: A traceable partner provided reference related to this appointment request. For example an order number, ticket number or similar. Mandatory when scenario = NEW

serviceOffering.description: An object holding the Telstra service offering details being requested by the partner. Mandatory when scenario = NEW

serviceCatalogue.description: An object holding the details of the service catalogue related to this offering.

name.description: The name of the catalogue instance within the Telstra service catalogue.

serviceCandidate.description: An array holding the service candidates under the catalogue being requested. For a simplex appointment type a max of two items will be supported. For complex/bundle requests only one is allowed.

place.description: An object which defines the location of the appointment visit. Mandatory when scenario = NEW

id.description: The Telstra address ID. Mandatory when place > type = TELSTRA ADDRESS ID

appointmentCategory.description: The category of the appointment. Mandatory when scenario = NEW

appointmentType.description: The type of appointment under the category. Mandatory when scenario = NEW

appointmentSubType.description: The sub type of the appointment under the category/type. Mandatory when scenario = NEW

priority.description: Indicates the priority of the request. Common values are recorded below, but individual partners may be given additional bespoke values outside of this list.

searchStartDate.description: The earliest date/time from which available appointments should be searched in Australia/Sydney time. Value must be a future date/time.

timeFilter.description: Allows indication of the time bracket if applicable. If there is no time bracket requirement then the field should not be sent.

appointmentID.description: The existing appointmentID to be rescheduled. Mandatory when scenario = RESCHEDULE

rescheduleReasonCode.description: The code indicating the reason for the reschedule being required. Mandatory when scenario = RESCHEDULE
enum: 51 (Request date change by customer or partner)
